## 1. `updateProjectManifestObject` — prototype-pollution safety
`pkg-manifest/utils/src/updateProjectManifestObject.ts`

Added a `setDependency` helper that uses `Object.defineProperty` (data descriptor: writable/enumerable/configurable) instead of plain assignment, and routed all three write sites through it. `resolving/npm-resolver/src/fetch.ts`

- Returns `undefined` (no suggestion) when there's no version suffix or stripping would leave an empty name (e.g. bare `1.0.0`).
